resources.string: Sessions shorter than the nap threshold: how they are estimated and written

Sessions shorter than this are naps, longer ones nights. Naps are never compared with the heart-rate baseline nor counted for it, and the stage-share check skips them. 0 = no naps: every session is a night. Sessions shorter than the minimum session length of the sources are ignored altogether.

Stages: like a night. Asleep / awake: only sleep and awakenings (nap stage estimates are rough). Nothing: naps are not estimated and nothing is written; a session written for a nap earlier is removed when it is recomputed.
The estimator of naps; the one of nights is set under Algorithm.
Check the stage shares of naps
Apply the sanity check (and the proportion calibration, when it is on) to naps too. Off by default: the whole-night ranges do not describe a nap, which often has no deep or REM sleep at all.
Shorter deep-sleep bouts of a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights.
Shorter REM bouts of a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights.
Shorter awakenings inside a nap are absorbed by a neighbour. Empty = the value of nights.
A nap with less deep sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights.
A nap with more deep sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights.
A nap with more REM sleep is marked low-confidence (only when the stage shares of naps are checked). Empty = the value of nights.
Epochs of a nap whose most likely stage has a lower probability are uncertain. Empty = the value of nights.
Keep the decoder\'s stage or write light sleep for the uncertain epochs of naps.
How the hybrid decoder models bout lengths in naps.
How strongly the classifier\'s output counts in naps. Empty = the value of nights.
Weight of the typical stage at this time since the session start, in naps. Empty = the value of nights.
No naps in the list. Sessions shorter than the nap threshold appear here once they are at least as long as the minimum session length of the sources.
Nap estimates are rough: on test data about 6 in 10 of the 30-second epochs of a nap matched the sleep lab, against about 5 in 10 for calling everything light sleep. Take the stages as a rough guide.
Written to Health Connect as asleep / awake only; the stages shown here are the app\'s estimate.
